// Command other exists only so that a view has something to exclude.
package main

import "github.com/richardwooding/forge/sdk/tool"

type Args struct {
	N int `json:"n"`
}

type Out struct {
	N int `json:"n"`
}

var _ = tool.Register(
	tool.Spec{Name: "other", Summary: "Not in the conformance view", Labels: []string{"excluded"}},
	tool.Op("run", run, tool.ReadOnly()),
)

func main() {}

func run(ctx *tool.Context, a Args) (Out, error) { return Out{N: a.N}, nil }
